content: A knowledge base holds the files the assistant looks for answers in. Connect it to a chat or an agent.

comment.text: Description on the empty screen of the Knowledge bases list in the AI Chat section for a user who may create one: what a knowledge base is and why to create it. Terms: agent = an AI assistant set up with a model, skill sets and knowledge bases; skill set = a room of skills (Markdown instructions); knowledge base = a room of files the assistant searches. Match Common:Agents, Common:SkillSets, Common:AIProjectKnowledgeRooms.
